goal: Reduce repeated immutable private reads while retaining current selected history, source consent and mutable producer authority.
procedure: Retrieve completed native cancellation logs and identify the actual completed and unreached tests. Reproduce episode lineage amplification using existing SQL-recording component fixtures without treating them as a selected-engine substitute. Authenticate actual selected held history once at each context-lineage entry; after producer callbacks and before return, use current selected metadata over the exact held history, binding the same authority object. Retain the reader's existing initial actual authentication and change only repeated current-head fixture inner reads to fresh metadata fences. Reuse already authenticated attachment plaintext within the same custody read for contract validation, checking exact roles, hashes and lengths and surrounding validation with current source guards. Reinvoke mutable episode formation and adjudication ports on every accepted read. Add actual selected-controller routing and producer-withdrawal regression, attachment no-reopen and validation-withdrawal regressions, and changed-adjudication regression.
authority: Procedure trace only. It grants no source or evaluation permission, qualifies no independent producer, factory, meter or ownership verifier, and supplies no learned behavior or FBM target.
validation: Method-only baseline regression observed four full selected history authentications versus one required; fixed actual selected history/session regression passed and refused producer-callback withdrawal. Eleven lineage contracts passed. Ninety-five affected custody, episode, state, runtime and context contracts passed. Existing component instrumentation reproduced 38,877 SQL calls and 1,700 episode current_lineage traversals per context-lineage operation; attachment reuse reduced those to 34,725 and 1,508. All eighteen owned-reader contracts passed in 41.974 seconds. Both physical native jobs reached their one-hour cap before selected reader-session and PGconn fault cases, so this change still requires a new exact-commit physical run.
failure_or_lesson: Initial immutable private authentication must not be repeated inside every current-authority fence. Held exact bytes can be reused only with fresh actual metadata and current source consent; mutable external verifier results cannot be cached. A delayed unittest error summary hid native comparison and pilot tracebacks when the job cap arrived, so infrastructure diagnostics must report failures immediately.
notes: Actual selected-engine logs establish completed lifecycle observations only. Worker outputs, meter counters and ownership/phase qualifications remain explicit fictional transport fixtures. No completed learned comparison or response-latency claim is made.
